m2_definition.definition: A complete rights-cleared Brunei routing-assignment snapshot for a source-attested current national edition covers all four districts, with locality, government-organization, postal-branch and non-spatial P.O. box semantics kept separate; exact provider lineage, row/page identity, coverage reconciliation, validity, exceptions, source and terms SHA-256, reproducible transformation, approved immutable artifacts and real AGID lookup verification are required. Postal geometry and exact civic-address/building relations are separate optional layers, never inferred from assignments or prefixes.

definition_review.review_basis: Existing BN manifest required exact postal row authority, edition, coverage, retrieval time and rights; the missing named criterion is now explicit, not a metadata-only or historical-sample promotion.
definition_review.national_scope: Four districts and typed non-locality assignments; source completeness must be reconciled rather than guessed from headings or valid syntax.

rights_review.postal_booklet: SKN public access and PDF metadata do not establish redistribution rights, current PosBru attestation or byte identity with the unavailable original. No explicit reuse notice was found in extracted booklet text; this is not a legal finding that no rights exist.
rights_review.posbru: Reviewed pages show All Rights Reserved and empty hrefs for Privacy Policy/Disclaimer/Terms of Use. Current operator status is not an open-data licence; VPO customer/transaction access is outside scope.
rights_review.deps_positive_basis: DEPS terms clause 2.1 permits reuse, copying, transmission, translation and modification of covered site content with source attribution, change notice and no endorsement; privacy, third-party content, disclaimer and site-specific scope still apply. This does not license SKN/Postal Services/PosBru/Survey artifacts.
rights_review.survey: Paid map products and identity/title-based address requests require exact use and redistribution authority; do not accept terms or request records.

authority_boundaries.postal: Historical booklet organization, locality and office tables remain distinct. Source page/section/row identity is necessary; code and serial alone are not stable IDs.
authority_boundaries.geometry: none for observed assignments; district/Mukim/village labels and routing prefixes are not official polygons; derived or virtual geometry must remain separately labeled.
authority_boundaries.address: No inference of house, building, entrance, owner, recipient or delivery entitlement from booklet rows, map proximity or current operator identity.
authority_boundaries.po_box: UPU format evidence is non-spatial routing semantics, not a box-subscriber register or exact home location.
